answer_1.quote: The AG method aims to inject values by training LLMs to generate opinions on issues consistent with the targeted value distribution. The QA method, on the other hand, trains LLMs to specify how similar they are to a given description of a person, on a 6-point scale from 'Not like me at all' to 'Very much like me.'
answer_1.outputs: arguments, stances, premises, survey responses (e.g., PVQ answers), behavior predictions (agree/disagree), opinion predictions (e.g., ESS responses)

answer_2.quote: We introduce a metric called Normalized Mean Squared Error (NMSE), which represents the difference between the normalized (between 0 and 1) predicted value scores Ŷi and the normalized target value scores Y i .

answer_4.quote: three human annotators were presented with two arguments...and asked to determine which argument better reflects the target value distribution.
answer_4.guideline: determine which argument better reflects the target value distribution
